description: App icon: a glowing lantern held up against a dark horde of red eyes, lantern gold #C9A227 light on night #1B1A2E.
Boot splash: the hooded lantern bearer standing in a moonlit graveyard clearing, warm lantern light pushing back a ring of shadowy monsters; isometric low-poly painted look.
Font of all text in Korean and English: a sturdy readable sans with bold weight for HUD numbers.
Title screen backdrop: an isometric night graveyard with dead trees, gravestones and a single warm lantern glow in the center; dark edges so the title text reads.
Camp (lobby) backdrop: a small camp at the edge of a dark forest with a campfire, a stone lantern shrine glowing gold and a tent; soft and dark so panels stay readable.
Run ground: tileable hand-painted mossy grass and dirt patches seen from above, night tones (#3E5C3A moss, #1B1A2E shadows); seamless on all edges, repeated over the whole field.

The player: a hooded lantern bearer in a moss-green cloak #3E5C3A holding a glowing gold lantern #C9A227 in the left hand; faces +Z; pivot at the feet. Stylized low-poly 3D with hand-painted textures, chunky readable silhouette for an isometric camera; palette night #1B1A2E, moss #3E5C3A, lantern gold #C9A227, blood red #8E1F2F, bone #E8E1D0.

A weapon hits an enemy: a quick burst of gold-white sparks at the hit point, gone within about 0.25 s; one shot, small (about 0.6 m).
An enemy dies: a puff of dark purple smoke and a few bone chips spreading on the ground, gone within about 0.5 s; one shot, about 1 m.
The player levels up: a column of gold light and rising sparks around the player, about 0.8 s; one shot.
A lightning strike lands: a blue-white flash and electric sparks scattering on the ground, about 0.4 s; one shot, about 1.5 m.
A gem or soup is picked up: a few small sparkles toward the player, about 0.3 s; one shot.

A weapon hit lands on an enemy: a bright warm white-gold flash disc with a thin ring of light and a few short streaks, about 1.4 m across and gone within about 0.2 s, so every hit reads from the isometric camera that shows about 30 m of ground; one shot.
The lantern of the hero fires a bolt: a quick burst of gold light and sparks at the lantern (about 1.5 m above the ground), about 1 m across, gone within about 0.15 s; one shot.
The hero starts walking, turns or stops: a small low puff of grey-brown dust at the feet spreading over the ground, about 1 m across, gone within about 0.4 s; one shot.

Frame of every panel and popup (lobby, shrine, options, level up, pause, result): dark night #1B1A2E painted panel with an aged gold border and corner rivets. Hand-painted UI over a dark night palette (#1B1A2E) with lantern gold #C9A227 edges and bone #E8E1D0 highlights.

Every button: a dark wooden plate with a thin gold edge, slightly lighter in the middle. Hand-painted UI over a dark night palette (#1B1A2E) with lantern gold #C9A227 edges and bone #E8E1D0 highlights.

Main action button (start run, buy, run again): a lantern gold #C9A227 plate with a darker gold edge and a warm inner glow. Hand-painted UI over a dark night palette (#1B1A2E) with lantern gold #C9A227 edges and bone #E8E1D0 highlights.

Frame of the health and XP bars: a thin dark iron frame with rounded ends and a transparent inside. Hand-painted UI over a dark night palette (#1B1A2E) with lantern gold #C9A227 edges and bone #E8E1D0 highlights.

Fill of the health and XP bars: a near-white soft gradient strip with rounded ends that code tints red for health and blue for XP. Hand-painted UI over a dark night palette (#1B1A2E) with lantern gold #C9A227 edges and bone #E8E1D0 highlights.

Camp (lobby) BGM: a quiet night camp tune with a soft lute, crackling-fire warmth and distant owl ambience; calm and hopeful.
Run BGM: a driving dark-fantasy action loop with taiko-like drums, low strings and a heroic lantern motif that grows; tense but steady so hit sounds stay clear.
Click of a UI button on every screen: a soft wooden tick.
A weapon hits an enemy: a short punchy thud with a light crunch.
An enemy is defeated: a small bony crumble with a soft magic pop.
An XP gem is picked up: a tiny bright crystal chime.
The player levels up: a rising warm magical chime with a little fanfare.
A level-up choice is picked: a confident bright sparkle.
The player takes a hit: a dull impact with a short grunt-like thud.
The elite chest opens: a wooden lid creak and a shimmering treasure glow.
The elite bone knight arrives: a deep echoing roar with armor clank.
The player eats soup and heals: a warm soft chime.
Dawn breaks at the end of the run: a bright choir swell and birdsong.
The player falls: a low falling tone and a lantern going out.
A shrine upgrade is bought: coins clink and a lantern flares up.
An action is refused (not enough gold): a short soft buzz.
The lantern bolt fires: a soft magical whoosh.
The spinning scythe slices: a short metallic swish.
The holy aura burns: a low soft flame pulse.
An axe is thrown: a spinning whoosh.
A lightning bolt strikes: a sharp crackle and a short thunder clap.
Title scene of the boot with the game name over the title backdrop.
Camp (lobby) scene after sign-in with the start, shrine and option buttons.
Run scene: the isometric 3D field, the player, the horde and the HUD.
Loading screen of every scene transition.
Terms popup of the first sign-in.
Root panel of the camp: title, gold, record and the start, shrine and option buttons.
Lantern shrine panel over the camp: one row per permanent upgrade with its level, effect, cost and buy button.
Option panel over the camp with the account and document entries.
Root panel of the run: health and XP bars, level, timer, kills, gold and the weapon slots.
Level-up and chest popup of the run with three choice cards.
Pause popup of the run with continue and give up.
Result panel at the end of a run with time, kills, level, gold and the run again and camp buttons.
A floating damage number over a hit enemy.
Pooled hit spark at an enemy a weapon hit.
Pooled death puff where an enemy fell.
Pooled lightning strike: the bolt model and its impact sparks.
Pooled level-up light around the player.
Pooled sparkle when the player picks up a gem, soup or chest.
Pooled lantern flash at the hero when the lantern bolt fires.
Pooled dust puff at the feet of the hero when it starts walking, turns or stops.
A damage number pops up, rises a little and fades.
A HUD number (level, kills, gold) swells and settles when it changes.
A level-up choice card drops in from above and settles with a small bounce.
A short blood red flash over the screen when the player is hit.
A warm gold flash over the screen when the player levels up.
A long bright white-gold fade when dawn breaks.
A warning banner (elite, dawn near) pops in, holds and fades.
The result panel title drops in large and settles.
How long a pooled one-shot effect of the run lives; its root keeps its size.
A lightning strike thins out and vanishes.
A bought shrine row swells with a gold glow and settles.
The start run button gently breathes to draw the eye.
Low health pulse of the run HUD health bar and the player health bar: opacity dips and comes back, repeating while health is low.
Fall of the player: the field fades to a blood red tint (#8E1F2F, half opacity) on the world screen effect and stays until the result.
Fall of the player: the hero model tips over forward with a small bounce.

Camp top band behind the game name, the gold and the option button: a dark night #1B1A2E translucent strip that fades out at its bottom, with an aged gold trim line and small filigree near the bottom edge. Hand-painted UI over a dark night palette (#1B1A2E) with lantern gold #C9A227 edges and bone #E8E1D0 highlights.

Header ribbon behind panel and card titles (shrine, record card, options, result, level up, pause): a wide aged gold-edged dark ribbon banner with folded ends; the middle stretches, the folded ends stay. Hand-painted UI over a dark night palette (#1B1A2E) with lantern gold #C9A227 edges and bone #E8E1D0 highlights.

Notice badge on the camp shrine button that holds the count of upgrades the gold covers: a round blood red #8E1F2F gem badge with a thin gold rim and a bright top highlight; the number is drawn over its center. Hand-painted UI over a dark night palette (#1B1A2E) with lantern gold #C9A227 edges and bone #E8E1D0 highlights.

Option button icon on the camp top band: an aged gold cogwheel with a small lantern flame in its hub, read at 64 px. Hand-painted UI over a dark night palette (#1B1A2E) with lantern gold #C9A227 edges and bone #E8E1D0 highlights.

Lantern shrine button icon at the camp: a small stone shrine with a glowing gold lantern inside it and a soft warm glow, read at 96 px. Hand-painted UI over a dark night palette (#1B1A2E) with lantern gold #C9A227 edges and bone #E8E1D0 highlights.

Run count icon on the camp record card: a worn leather boot print on a winding night path with a lantern-gold outline, read at 56 px. Hand-painted UI over a dark night palette (#1B1A2E) with lantern gold #C9A227 edges and bone #E8E1D0 highlights.

Dawn count icon on the camp record card and the dawn result: a rising sun over a dark hill line, warm gold rays against night blue, read at 56 px. Hand-painted UI over a dark night palette (#1B1A2E) with lantern gold #C9A227 edges and bone #E8E1D0 highlights.

Level icon on the result panel: an aged gold star medallion with a small lantern flame, read at 56 px. Hand-painted UI over a dark night palette (#1B1A2E) with lantern gold #C9A227 edges and bone #E8E1D0 highlights.

Filled level pip of a lantern shrine upgrade row: a small diamond gem lit lantern gold with a bright core, read at 28 px; sits in a row of pips next to empty pips. Hand-painted UI over a dark night palette (#1B1A2E) with lantern gold #C9A227 edges and bone #E8E1D0 highlights.

Empty level pip of a lantern shrine upgrade row: the same small diamond shape as the filled pip but an empty dark iron socket with a thin dim gold edge, read at 28 px. Hand-painted UI over a dark night palette (#1B1A2E) with lantern gold #C9A227 edges and bone #E8E1D0 highlights.

Camp hero figure standing by the campfire in the middle of the camp screen: the lone lantern bearer of model/hero (moss green hooded cloak, leather armor, a warm glowing lantern raised in the left hand), full body, three-quarter view, confident stance, warm firelight on the right side and cool moonlight rim on the left; transparent background, no ground shadow. Stylized low-poly 3D with hand-painted textures, the same look as model/hero.

Ornament behind the game name on the title screen and the camp top band: a symmetric aged gold filigree crest with a lantern in the center and swept wings of light to both sides, an empty dark band across the middle where the name text sits; no letters. Hand-painted UI over a dark night palette (#1B1A2E) with lantern gold #C9A227 edges and bone #E8E1D0 highlights.

Camp ambience over the backdrop: warm orange-gold embers rise slowly from the campfire at the lower middle of the screen, drift sideways a little, flicker and fade out about a third of the way up; 20 to 40 alive at once, small (4 to 10 px), loops while the camp is shown. Placed at the campfire, emits in screen space.
